item.title: Voxel Raytracer Devlog
item.description: Sparse ray marching with axis-aligned distance fields 2026-08-25 Commits: b87de9a c191bb8 a251277 f332529 The existing DDA renderer is completely rewritten. A sparse raymarcher, using nested axis-aligned distance fields (NAADFs) is implemented, inspired by Globally Illuminated Voxel Worlds Accelerated with Nested Axis‐Aligned Distance Fields. Brick coordinate rasterization is removed in favor of a simpler pipeline. This method seems like a really promising way to implement both the basic gbuffer + RTAO rendering, as well as a potential path tracer.
